recognize_zh: Ki-67 免疫染色下，大量中至大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞核強陽性，粗估約一半以上的腫瘤細胞為陽性且分布無極性，顯示高增殖指數，符合高級別濾泡性淋巴瘤（3B 級）。
features: Numerous tumor nuclei with strong nuclear Ki-67 staining
Positive cells are medium to large with round to irregular nuclei
Estimated proliferation index roughly 50-60% in this field, without zonal polarization
Negative small cells and spindle stromal cells interspersed
Architecture (follicle boundaries) not evaluable at this magnification
describe_en: Ki-67 immunohistochemical stain shows strong nuclear positivity in a large proportion of medium to large neoplastic cells, estimated at roughly half or more of tumor cells in this field, distributed without the polarized pattern of a reactive germinal center. Interspersed small cells and stromal cells are negative. The high proliferation index supports a high-grade follicular lymphoma and, with sheets of centroblasts, is consistent with follicular lymphoma, grade 3B; Ki-67 alone does not substitute for centroblast counting in grading.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL typically has a Ki-67 index below 20-30%, although some cases show discordantly high proliferation.
Reactive germinal centers have very high Ki-67 with a polarized dark-zone/light-zone distribution and are BCL2-negative.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a near 100% Ki-67 index in a monotonous medium-sized population, higher than the index seen here.
DLBCL may have a similar proliferation index, so distinction requires demonstrating follicular architecture with CD21/CD23.
